page.title: Galement Reckoner
page.heading: Galement reckoner
page.reset_help: Clear your set-up and settings, and see the first screen again (kept set-ups stay)

bedrock.label: Bedrock
bedrock.help: Bedrock Edition: each galement costs only the ranks it adds, Sticking is cheaper, and there is no Sweeping Edge

wanted.intro: Find the cheapest anvil order to put galed books on a thing. Pick the thing and its galements, then follow the steps.
wanted.example: Try an example: Depth Strider boots
wanted.graph_hint: {nodes} galements, {edges} clashes. Hover or focus one to see its clashes; click to choose it.
wanted.expand_groups_label: Unfold all groups and boxes in Galements
wanted.collapse_groups_label: Fold all groups and boxes in Galements
wanted.legend_one: In a Pick one, choose one, or none. Choosing another puts it away.
wanted.legend_side: The sides cannot go together: take from one side only. Each side shows its own rule.
wanted.legend_part: The parts never clash: take from any of them, each by its own rule.
wanted.legend_any: In a Pick any, the galements go together: choose as many as you will.
wanted.legend_stray: Also clashes with a thing in another side or part (hover it to see what).
wanted.legend_badges: Badges that number the sides and parts of a group.
wanted.cost_meter_help: Anvil ranks for the best order with the books below
wanted.preset_best_help: The usual best galements for this thing, at the highest rank, without curses
wanted.preset_swap_help: The best set, with {name} in place of what it clashes with

cost_help.one: About {levels} rank to add this from a book, before any earlier work
cost_help.other: About {levels} ranks to add this from a book, before any earlier work

wanted.short_help: Your books and things in the Books and things section cannot reach the rank chosen here.

books.automatic_help: One book for each galement chosen in the Galements section
books.custom_help: List your own books and things, with copies and earlier work

prior_work_cost.one: Its earlier work adds {levels} rank to each merge it is in.
prior_work_cost.other: Its earlier work adds {levels} ranks to each merge it is in.

books.prior_work_none: Never used on an anvil, so no extra cost.
books.edit_line: Change galements, or drag onto another entry to move it
books.coverage_label: Galements chosen in the Galements section, reached or not
books.cover_toggle: Show or hide the galements already reached
books.chip_drag_hint: Drag onto an entry to put it there
books.duplicate_help: Add a copy of this entry, to change it

copies_edit.one: Copies: {count}. Use − and +, or scroll over it
copies_edit.other: Copies: {count}. Use − and +, or scroll over it

books.type_placeholder: Write a book: prot 4, mending, x3
books.type_label: Add one book by writing its galements, with commas between them; add x3 for three copies
books.reorder_help: Drag to reorder, or focus and press the up and down arrow keys
books.copies_help: How many identical copies of this you have, e.g. a stack of the same book
books.prior_work_help: How many times this has already been used on an anvil. Each use makes later merges dearer.
books.alert_auto_note: One book for each chosen galement; your own list is put away.
books.unwanted_help: Not chosen in Galements. It will still go on the thing and cost ranks.

ranking.rank_by: The best order is picked by the four tiles below: the order with the lowest value in the first tile wins, and the next tiles break ties. Drag a tile, or use its ‹ › arrows, to change which counts most.
ranking.rank_help_label: How the best order is chosen

xp.label: XP
xp.help: Total XP points spent. Higher ranks cost more XP each.

max_step.label: Most rank
max_step.help: Most ranks spent on one anvil use

prior_work.label: Earlier work
prior_work.help: Earlier work on the result: the lower it is, the cheaper later anvil use on it will be

ranking.show_motion_help: Off, nothing on the page slides, fades or moves (glints have their own switch). It is kept in this browser; the page also follows your device's reduced-motion setting.
ranking.glints_reduced: Off: your device asks for reduced motion
ranking.glints_help: The slow purple sheen over galed things and chosen galements. It keeps running when Show animations is off; turn it off here.
ranking.rules_reset_help: Rank limit 39 and no clashes, as in the game
ranking.allow_conflicts_help: For mods that let clashing galements go together
ranking.mods_help: Adds a mod's galements to the lists. The numbers come from the mod's own files and may differ in your version.
ranking.level_limit_help: No anvil use may cost more ranks than this
ranking.level_limit_label: Most ranks allowed per anvil use
ranking.rename_help: Type a name to rename the thing in the last step (+1 rank). Leave it blank for no rename.
ranking.rename_label: New name for the finished thing
ranking.your_level_help: Your XP rank now, to see what you have left after each step
ranking.set_needed_help: Set your rank to exactly what the steps not yet ticked need
ranking.use_level_help: Follow your rank through the steps: the rank before and after each one

results.slow_search: {count} entries: this may take a while.
results.too_many_different: Too many different entries. Repeated books are fine, but at most 20 different ones.
results.no_valid_order: No fitting order: these cannot be joined.
results.no_valid_order_within: No fitting order within the {limit}-rank limit.
results.limit_lowered_hint: Every order has a step above your limit.
results.too_expensive_hint: Every order has a step of 40 ranks or more, which the game refuses (“Too Dear!”). Books with less earlier work, or fewer galements per book, may help.
results.break_step: Without a limit the best order has {steps} steps, and step {number} costs {levels} ranks: over your limit of {limit}.
results.break_beyond: Even without a limit, step {number} costs {levels} ranks. The game stops at {game}.
results.extra_help: These came along on your books or things. They are included in the cost.
results.round_help: These steps do not need each other's results, so do them in any order.
results.step_done_help: Tick off steps as you do them. Kept in this browser.
results.anvil_safe: A new anvil will not break
results.anvil_wear_help: Each anvil use has a 12% chance to damage the anvil. A new anvil breaks on its third damage.
results.compact_help: Show only the slots, with the details when you hover

step_instruction.one: Put {left} in the left slot and {right} in the right slot. Take the result: it costs {levels} rank.
step_instruction.other: Put {left} in the left slot and {right} in the right slot. Take the result: it costs {levels} ranks.

results.step_rename_note: Type “{name}” in the name box first.

checkpoint.one: Gain {count} rank first: you need rank {level}
checkpoint.other: Gain {count} ranks first: you need rank {level}

results.copy_checklist_help: Copy the steps as a checklist, with a box for each
results.copy_steps_help: Copy the steps as text, e.g. to paste in a chat
results.print_help: Print the steps, or save them as a PDF
results.share_help: Copy the steps or the link, or print them
results.copy_link_help: Copy a link to this set-up, with the steps you have ticked

text_totals.one: {levels} rank in total ({xp} XP), at most {max_step} in one step
text_totals.other: {levels} ranks in total ({xp} XP), at most {max_step} in one step

results.worker_failed: The reckoner failed to load. Check the browser console for details.
results.metadata_failed: Could not load the galement data. Serve this folder over HTTP instead of opening the file directly.

descriptions.aqua_affinity: Mine at full speed under water
descriptions.bane_of_arthropods: Extra harm to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites
descriptions.binding_curse: Cannot be taken off once worn
descriptions.blast_protection: Less harm and knockback from blasts
descriptions.breach: Blows go through some of the foe's armour
descriptions.channeling: Thrown in a thunderstorm, it calls lightning down on the foe
descriptions.density: Smash blows do more harm the farther you fall
descriptions.fire_protection: Less harm from fire, and burning stops sooner
descriptions.fortune: More drops from ores and crops
descriptions.frost_walker: Turns water to ice as you walk over it
descriptions.infinity: Shooting does not use up arrows (you need one)
descriptions.loyalty: The trident comes back after it is thrown
descriptions.luck_of_the_sea: Better chance of treasure when fishing
descriptions.mending: Experience you pick up mends the thing
descriptions.projectile_protection: Less harm from arrows and other missiles
descriptions.riptide: Thrown in water or rain, it launches you with it
descriptions.silk_touch: Blocks drop themselves, like ores and glass
descriptions.soul_speed: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil
descriptions.thorns: Hurts the foes and players that strike you
descriptions.wind_burst: Smash blows bounce you back up into the air
